notes.title: Demo - Small Patch! v1.02 is out.
notes.content:
Patch v1.02 is out! This is a smaller one aimed at fixing some struggling areas.

[h2]Patch Notes -[/h2]
[h3]Features -[/h3]
- Reworked Sarah's Bedroom. Removing the Enemy and added a hint for the other puzzle. 
- Volume slider added to Options!
- Increased the visibility of important objects in the tutorial as well as some text giving more clear direction.

[h3]Fixes -[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where you could move after attacking once whilst in attack stance
- Fixed music audio dropping after using Peeking

Still working on the bigger Controller update, but wanted to get this out sooner.

Cya soon!

notes.title: Deprived Demo v1.01 out now!
notes.content:
Patch v1.01 is out! Should clean up the remaining issues from the release version.

[h2]Patch Notes -[/h2]
[h3]Features - [/h3]
  - Choice made at the 3 doors now changes the Demo Ending text.
  - Sarah room puzzle improved clarity overall (TV picture frame redone for example).
  - 912 door was hard to notice, so welcome mat is moved to draw attention.
  - Removed some non-relevant notepad updates, and now it'll popup at more important events.
  - [spoiler]Updated text on Ending E.[/spoiler]

[h3]Fixes - [/h3]
  - Movement/Flashlight tutorials now work with a Controller and will go away.
  --- (and are on a timer if you ignore them for too long).
  - Fixed Bedroom door sometimes being locked when beating the puzzles.
  - Fixed small chance of ending text not playing.
  - Stopped player actions during intro to avoid issues.
  - Fixed a typo in Intro text

Next update will allow FULL controller support! Right now, you can use an xbox controller and play through the game fine - besides using the mouse for inventory and such. 

[h3]Coming up:[/h3]
Controller menu navigation, controller prompts on the UI, and reworked tutorial text to include keyboard+controller.
